item.title: Mars completes acquisition of Kellanova in $35.9-billion snacking deal
item.description: New Delhi: Mars, Incorporated, has completed its acquisition of Kellanova, bringing together some of the world’s biggest snacking brands under one company. The deal, first announced in August 2024, values Kellanova at about $35.9 billion, with shareholders receiving $83.50 per share in cash. item.title: Disney to let OpenAI’s Sora use Marvel, Pixar, Star Wars characters in three-year AI deal
item.description: New Delhi: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI have entered into a three-year agreement that will bring hundreds of Disney characters to Sora, OpenAI’s short-form generative AI video platform, and make Disney a major customer and investor in the AI company. item.title: Honasa Consumer acquires Reginald Men owner BTM Ventures for Rs 195 crore
item.description: New Delhi: Honasa Consumer, the parent company of Mamaearth and The Derma Co, has announced the acquisition of BTM Ventures, owner of men’s grooming brand Reginald Men, at an enterprise value of Rs 195 crore as it looks to build a stronger play in the fast-growing men’s personal care market. Founded in August 2022 by Trisha Reddy Talasani, Reginald Men offers a curated range of men’s personal care products with a strong focus on sunscreens and serums. item.title: India’s CTV surge is unstoppable, but trust gaps worry advertisers
item.description: New Delhi: WPP’s This Year, Next Year (TYNY) 2026 report forecasts a powerful surge in India’s Connected TV (CTV) advertising market, nearly 20% growth in 2025 and 22% in 2026, fuelled by booming smart-TV penetration, rising OTT consumption, and a strategic shift by brands toward premium video environments. item.title: Karan Johar and Bunty Sajdeh set to split Dharma Cornerstone partnership
item.description: New Delhi: The talent management partnership between Karan Johar and Bunty Sajdeh is headed for a separation, with both expected to run their ventures independently, according to news reports. The development effectively brings the Dharma Cornerstone Agency (DCA) to an end, five years after it was set up as a joint effort between Dharma Productions and Cornerstone. item.title: Authenticity in storytelling is a currency that can never be demonetised: Kamal Haasan
item.description: Chennai: Actor and Rajya Sabha MP Kamal Haasan said India’s media and entertainment business is entering a phase where change is being driven less by devices and more by audience behaviour, as stories become “screen agnostic” and travel with viewers across formats. item.title: WARC upgrades global ad spend forecast; India market seen rising to $13.8 bn in 2025
item.description: New Delhi: Global advertising spend is now on course to close out 2025 with growth of 8.9% to $1.19 trillion, an upgrade of 1.5 percentage points from WARC’s September forecast, driven by strong results from big tech platforms and a muted impact on global trade from trade tariffs, according to WARC’s latest outlook. item.title: Bombay HC upholds civic bodies’ right to levy licence fees on hoardings and sky-signs
item.description: New Delhi: Civic bodies have the power to regulate and levy fees for the grant and renewal of licences for sky-signs, hoardings and billboards, the Bombay High Court has held while dismissing petitions challenging municipal corporations’ decisions to levy such fees. item.title: Disney alleges Google’s AI is copying its characters in major copyright dispute
item.description: New Delhi: Disney has accused Google of engaging in copyright infringement on a “massive scale”, alleging that the company’s artificial intelligence tools have generated material resembling numerous Disney-owned characters and franchises, according to news reports. The development comes a day before Disney disclosed a $1 billion investment in OpenAI, a move seen as significant for the entertainment and technology sectors.
